Timberwolf .308.info:
A .308 Winchester conversion kit for the Timberwolf, turning it into the lighter Coyote rifle.
Possesses a simpler damage profile that allows you to kill to the torso up close, but lacks the raw power and performance of the other available ammo types.

Mateba 6 .454 Casull.info: Chambers your Mateba Autorevolver in .454 Casull - giving it a massive increase in stopping power up close at the cost of having a lower rate of fire, increased recoil, and slightly worse handling.

Saiga 223 Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in .223 Rem. with a 40 round magazine!
Uses some ''legal'' modifications to the receiver to turn your SAR fully automatic. Treat this as an assault rifle with an extended magazine!

SSR 6.5 Conversion.info:
Transforms your gun into the ''MK20S'' firing 6.5mm Creedmoor!
Slightly shorter round that has better velocity, lower recoil and the ability to one shot head at all ranges!
Significantly worse anywhere outside the head and reduced penetration!

Saiga 762 Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 7.62x39mm with a 30rd magazine!
Keeps damage high especially to the torso while also increasing your fire rate, but lowers overall damage and penetration!

M14 6.5.info:
Loads your M14 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
This cartridge offers your M14 more assault rifle characteristics such as lower damage, alongside a 30 round magazine. Slight improvements to penetration, velocity and recoil.

RPK12 7.62 Conversion.info:
A conversion kit chambering the RPK-12 for 7.62x39mm, designed as a potential replacement for the RPK in service to go alongside the 5.45x39 upgrade.

Increased damage and recoil with slightly less magazine capacity and a slightly longer reload time.

.17 HMR (Ruger).info:
Converts your R-10/22 rifle to fire .17 HMR, providing excellent velocity and long-range headshot performance. This conversion kit also comes with a modified charging handle that makes the gun manually operated, acting as a straight-pull bolt action!

Animation likely completely broken, WIP.

Saiga 545 Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.45x39mm with a 45 round magazine!
Lowers recoil, increases fire rate, magazine capacity and bullet speed while keeping a good range performance but comes at a cost of close range damage, penetration and some handling!

UMP 9 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-9.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

AUG .300 Conversion.info:
Loads your UAR A3 with supersonic .300 Blackout.
Improves close range damage and penetration at the cost of worse ranged damage and bullet speed.
Reduces radar detection range further by 50% with suppressors!

M21 6.5.info:
Loads your M21 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
Featuring a 20 round magazine, your M21 has its performance affected due 6.5mm. However, you suffer from weaker headshot damage and overall modifier reductions.

SVU-A Conversion Kit.info: Change the internals of your SVU sniper rifle into that of the SVU-A with an extended magazine. Treat it as a hard to control battle rifle (especially in auto which should only be used for emergencies)...

SCAR L 9mm Conversion.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM to fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit.
Uses a 50rd drum magazine. Focusses on CQC by increasing the fire rate, close range damage and reducing the recoil but at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and penetration!

RM277 7.62x51 Conversion.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire 7.62x51mm NATO, a more traditional cartridge with a more traditional damage profile.

High damage with a simplified damage profile but decreases fire rate and muzzle velocity and increases recoil.

AutoMag .50 AE Conversion.info:
Load your AutoMag with .50 Action Express.
This makes your AutoMag III into the .50 caliber AutoMag V using a 5-round magazine. Featuring stopping power similar to other .50 caliber handguns.

AK12BR 7.62 Conversion.info:
A conversion kit that rechambered the AK-12BR prototype for 7.62x39mm, using a more conventional drum magazine.
Lower recoil for the caliber, but also lower damage. High rate of fire.
